d: Embedded within the City Operations Finance & Control team, the Procurement Manager will support the Directors in delivering procurement across City Assets. As the City asset portfolio expands and procurement activity increases, the role will provide the additional capacity and coordination required to maintain timely delivery, robust governance and effective stakeholder support. The role will drive reporting and process discipline, coordinate activity across functions, support the preparation of approval papers, and help progress new and evolving contracts through the end-to-end procurement lifecycle.
q: Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in Procurement, Supply Chain or Commercial roles, preferably within a complex operating environment.
Practical experience supporting the full sourcing lifecycle and multiple concurrent procurement activities.
Experience preparing or contributing to procurement strategies, approval papers, tender documents, evaluations and contract award recommendations.
Strong reporting and analytical capability, with experience maintaining procurement pipelines, dashboards, KPIs and management information.
Sound commercial acumen, including pricing analysis, negotiation support, total cost considerations and identification of commercial risk.
Experience working across operational service categories such as public realm, facilities management, maintenance, utilities, security, transport, events or similar areas is advantageous.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to coordinate effectively across Operations, Procurement, Finance, Legal and other support functions.
Organized and delivery-focused, with the ability to manage competing priorities, follow through on actions and work effectively in a growing, high-pressure environment.
Clear written and verbal communication, with strong attention to detail and confidence preparing material for senior review.
Working knowledge of procurement governance, delegated authority, tender controls, supplier risk and contract management principles.
Bachelor's degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Business Administration, Commercial Management or a related field.
Professional qualification such as CIPS/MCIPS or CPSM is advantageous.
Experience in Saudi Arabia, the GCC, major development or large-scale operational environments is advantageous.
r: Support the Senior Manager and Directors in planning and delivering the City Operations procurement pipeline, ensuring priorities, dependencies and lead times are visible.
Coordinate end-to-end procurement activities, including requirements development, RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, bid evaluations, supplier selection, negotiation, award and contract execution.
Work with City asset and operational teams to develop clear scopes, commercial requirements and procurement documentation for new and evolving contracts.
Support the drafting and quality assurance of approval papers, tender documentation, evaluation materials and governance submissions.
Drive procurement reporting, dashboards and KPIs covering pipeline status, sourcing progress, approvals, risks, savings and key decisions required.
Maintain effective processes, trackers and workflows to improve procurement visibility, consistency and timely delivery.
Coordinate with central Procurement, Finance, Legal, Operations, IT and other stakeholders to progress reviews, approvals and contracting activities.
Support commercial negotiations and supplier engagement to secure competitive pricing, appropriate terms and value for money.
Ensure procurement activity complies with policy, delegated authority, governance, regulatory and audit-trail requirements.
Provide responsive day-to-day procurement support to City Operations stakeholders and escalate material risks or delays appropriately.

d: Responsible for the stable, secure and controlled operation of assigned business applications. The role provides end-to-end application ownership, coordinates incidents and changes, manages vendors and ensures that service performance, regulatory obligations, resilience and documentation requirements are maintained.
q: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related field.
Relevant application, database, cloud or technology certification is an advantage.
At least 8 years of application support or technology operations experience, including experience supporting critical banking applications.
r: Maintain agreed availability and service levels for assigned applications.
Ensure critical incidents, problems and production risks are managed within agreed timelines.
Maintain current support documentation, ownership records and recovery procedures.
Reduce recurring incidents through problem management and preventive remediation.
Act as primary owner for assigned applications and related support services.
Coordinate incident, problem, change and release activities across internal teams and vendors.
Monitor service health, capacity, batch processing, interfaces and operational controls.
Ensure patches, upgrades, vulnerability remediation and end-of-life actions are planned and completed.
Maintain application inventories, architecture references, runbooks, access matrices and recovery procedures.
Support audit, risk, compliance, Sharia and regulatory information requests where applicable.
Manage vendor performance, support cases, maintenance obligations and escalations.
Coordinate testing and production readiness for application changes.
Provide management reporting on service performance, risks, incidents and improvement plans.
Oversee the release of other non-related technology / application to ensure oversight and additional control as part of segregation of duties.
